AccountChargeResponse.description: A charge recorded from a statement or manual trade

AccountFeeResponse.description: A fee charged to an account

AccountStatementResponse.description: An uploaded broker statement with its latest import result

AccountTaxResponse.description: A tax charged to an account

AdjustmentRequest.description: Adjusts the cash balance to reconcile with a broker statement. Positive adds cash, negative removes it

BuyTradeRequest.description: Buys shares at the current market price

ChargeLineResponse.description: One line of a fee or tax breakdown

ChargeSummaryResponse.description: Charges of an account for a year: imported/manual charges and platform fee-engine fees,

CreateAccountRequest.description: Opens a new investment account for the authenticated user

DividendRequest.description: Posts a cash dividend for a symbol held in the account (internal, service-to-service)

DividendResponse.description: A dividend paid into an account

FeeBreakdownResponse.description: Fee preview from the fee engine

FeeMasterResponse.description: An entry of the fee schedule

FeeRequest.description: Asks the fee engine for a fee preview without charging anything

HoldingResponse.description: Shares of one symbol held in an account, with live valuation

InterestRequest.description: Posts interest on the cash balance for a period (internal, service-to-service)

LedgerResponse.description: One ledger entry with its running balance

ManualTradeRequest.description: Records a trade done at an external broker on a tracking account. Never moves cash

MonthAmountResponse.description: A total for one calendar month

SellTradeRequest.description: Sells held shares at the current market price

TaxBreakdownResponse.description: Tax preview from the tax engine

TaxRequest.description: Asks the tax engine for a tax preview without charging anything

TaxSummaryResponse.description: Taxes of an account for a year

TradeResponse.description: A trade: executed here, entered manually, or imported from a statement

UpdateAccountRequest.description: Changes the editable details of an account

WithdrawRequest.description: Pays cash out of an account. The withdrawal fee is charged on top of the amount

info.description:
Investment accounts, cash ledger, trades, holdings, fees, taxes,
dividends and statements.

Every endpoint except the fee/tax schedules requires the X-User-Id
header, which the api-gateway sets from the validated JWT.
Dividend and interest posting are internal endpoints that the
gateway blocks.
info.title: Account Service API

post.description: Creates an ACTIVE account with a zero balance.

get.description: The caller's own accounts; an ADMIN may list any existing user's accounts.

403.description: userId is not the caller and the caller is not ADMIN

get.description: Newest first, each with its latest import result.

post.description: Multipart field 'file': xlsx, xls or csv, at most 20 MB. The account must be an ACTIVE GROWW, ZERODHA, BINANCE or EXNESS account of the caller. The file is stored and imported right away; the response includes the import result.

400.description: Wrong file type, content, size or account

409.description: Same file already uploaded to this account

delete.description: Soft delete: the balance must be zero and no shares held. History stays readable.

400.description: Balance not zero, shares still held, or account not active

post.description: Positive amount adds cash, negative removes it; posted as a STATEMENT_ADJUSTMENT ledger entry.

422.description: A negative adjustment larger than the balance

get.description: Every action on the account with request/response JSON, newest first.

post.description: Pays dividendPerShare on the shares currently held, minus withholding tax. Requires X-User-Role ADMIN; the api-gateway only lets ADMIN tokens through.
Simple interest on the current balance for the period. Requires X-User-Role ADMIN; the api-gateway only lets ADMIN tokens through.

get.description: Inclusive date range, in ledger order.
Recalculates and returns gross profit, realized/unrealized profit, charges, taxes and net profit (netProfit = grossProfit - totalCharges - totalTaxes).
Opening/closing balance, ledger with running balance, trades, deposits/withdrawals, dividends, interest and fee/tax totals for an inclusive date range (max 366 days).
Cash, live value of holdings, realized/unrealized profit and lifetime totals.

post.description: The withdrawal fee is charged on top of the amount.

422.description: Balance does not cover amount + fee

get.description: Imported and manual charges, newest first.
Totals per charge type for a calendar year (default: current year), including the platform fee engine's fees.

post.description: What a trade or withdrawal of this amount would cost. Nothing is charged.

get.description: Live price fields are null when market-data-service is unavailable.

delete.description: Deletes the file, the statement and every trade, charge and tax imported from it; holdings are rebuilt.

get.description: Every import attempt of the statement, newest first.

post.description: Imports the stored file again (for example after a column mapping change). What it imported before is replaced, never duplicated.

get.description: Taxes of all sources for a calendar year (default: current year), per type and per month.

post.description: Trade tax, plus capital gains tax for a SELL with a positive realizedProfit. Nothing is charged.

Records a trade done at an external broker on a GROWW, ZERODHA, BINANCE, EXNESS or MANUAL account. Give buyPrice for a BUY, sellPrice for a SELL, or both for a closed position. Never moves cash; holdings are rebuilt.

400.description: Platform account, or a missing price

get.description: Newest first. Optional inclusive date range: give both from and to (yyyy-MM-dd).

post.description: Debits price x quantity + fees + taxes and adds to the holding.
Credits price x quantity, debits fees and taxes (incl. capital gains tax on profit).
